context: A teacher walks a teen through a project
purpose: Teach: 反撃/核心/燃える/揺れる/譲歩/一因/炎症/引き金

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、社会問題への反撃、市民の力ですね。
lines.en: Sakura — your response to these social issues really shows citizen power at work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured opening. Warm professional recognition. Slight lean-in on Sakura's name. Teacher's confidence without condescension.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。問題の核心、データで示しました。
lines.en: Yes. I made sure to back the core argument with data.
lines.style: Focused and direct. Light pride in the work, but not self-satisfied. Eyes steady on teacher. Slight nod at 「はい」.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 世論が燃える時、メディアの責任、重いですね。
lines.en: And when public opinion gets heated like this, the media's responsibility becomes even heavier.
lines.style: Steady, reflective tone. Slight pause before 「メディア」 — choosing the word deliberately. Conversational but intellectually engaged.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。揺れる議論、丁寧に整理しました。
lines.en: I worked to organize the conflicting viewpoints carefully — didn't rush through the complexity.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Small emphasis on 「丁寧に」. Defending her own clarity, not boasting. Slight breathiness at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 対立する側に譲歩する論点、章末で扱いましたね。
lines.en: I noticed you gave real weight to the opposing side's points toward the end of the chapter.
lines.style: Appreciative, observational. Leaning back slightly — acknowledging something subtle Sakura did. Warm and noticing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 貧困の一因、教育格差、論じました。
lines.en: I examined how education inequality works as one of the underlying causes of poverty.
lines.style: Even-paced, methodical. Small pause before 「教育格差」 — letting the weight of the term land. Serious but not heavy-handed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会の炎症みたいな緊張、章として扱いましたね。
lines.en: You treated that kind of systemic tension — the inflammation in the system itself — as something requiring a full chapter.
lines.style: Admiring, slower pace. Slight exhale on 「炎症」 — recognizing the sophistication of the metaphor. Teacher voice, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 政策変更の引き金、丁寧に分析しました。
lines.en: I traced what actually triggers policy change — the mechanisms — with real care.
lines.style: Closing statement with quiet finality. Measured, satisfied. No trailing-off. The work is complete and well-done.
